THE SPLIT PLATE / RECIPE

Strawberry Shortcake Roll Protein Creami

CrumblCreamiCut Week 10 Flavor 3 — strawberry-emulsion protein Creami with Entenmann's pound-cake pieces and a Smucker's strawberry syrup finish. About 350 calories and 41g protein for the complete pint.

YIELD1 serving
TOTAL TIME10 min active + overnight freeze + 5 min counter rest
COOK METHODSee method
EST. / SERVING~350 cal | ~41g protein
KEY TO SUCCESS: Keep the base otherwise unchanged except for the 1/4 tsp strawberry emulsion.

Ingredients

CREAMI BASE

  • 1 batch usual protein Creami base (240 cal / 40g protein)
  • 1/4 tsp strawberry emulsion (blend into base before freezing)

MIX-IN (after the first spin)

  • 1/2 Entenmann's Pound Mini Snack Cake (full 39g cake is 160 cal / 2g protein)

TOPPING

  • 1/2 tbsp Smucker's Strawberry Flavored Syrup

Allergens: dairy, eggs, wheat, gluten. Entenmann's Pound Mini Snack Cake commonly contains milk, eggs, and wheat. Verify the current physical label before publishing final allergen tags.

You want a strawberry-shortcake whole-pint Creami — strawberry-emulsion base, soft pound-cake pieces, and a strawberry syrup finish — at about half the calories of the Crumbl cookie and enough protein to work as a Powerup. Week 10 Flavor 3 of the CrumblCreamiCut series recreating current Crumbl flavors.

Method

  1. 1.BLEND BASE. Blend 1/4 teaspoon strawberry emulsion into your usual protein Creami base until completely smooth.
  2. 2.FREEZE. Pour into a Creami pint without exceeding the max-fill line. Freeze upright and level overnight.
  3. 3.FIRST SPIN. Rest the pint 5 minutes, then process on Regular Ice Cream. If it stays powdery, run one no-liquid Respin before the mix-in.
  4. 4.MIX-IN THE POUND CAKE. Cut a center well, press in half of one Entenmann's Pound Mini Snack Cake, and run Mix-In.
  5. 5.SCOOP. Scoop the Creami into a bowl.
  6. 6.DRIZZLE + SERVE. Finish with 1/2 tablespoon Smucker's Strawberry Flavored Syrup. Eat immediately for the intended texture.

Keys to success

  • The cake is exactly half of one Entenmann's Pound Mini Snack Cake and goes in on Mix-In, after the first spin.
  • Freeze the pint upright and level overnight; process on Regular Ice Cream, not Lite.

If something fails

Strawberry flavor is weak: Confirm a full 1/4 teaspoon of strawberry emulsion. Emulsion is more concentrated than extract, so measure level.

Powdery after Regular Ice Cream: Run one no-liquid Respin before pressing in the pound cake.

Pound cake disappeared into the pint: Cut a narrow center well and add the cake right before Mix-In so it stays in recognizable pieces.

Texture is gummy: The guar gum in the base was likely heaped. Use a level measure.

Storage and reheating

Store: Keep the unprocessed base frozen upright and level. Add the syrup and process only when ready to eat.

Reheat: N/A. If the processed base is powdery, use a no-liquid Respin before the mix-in.

Lasts: The frozen pre-spin pint keeps up to one week. The finished pint is best immediately after Mix-In and drizzle.

Estimated nutrition

~350 cal | ~41g protein.

About 350 calories and 41g protein for the complete finished pint. Rounded creator estimate. Flavor target
